sentences.text_target: Tom arrived at the clinic in the morning.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm əˈraɪvd æt ðə ˈklɪnɪk ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Tom est arrivé à la clinique le matin.

sentences.text_target: He walked to the reception desk.
sentences.text_native: Il s'est dirigé vers le bureau d'accueil.

sentences.text_target: The receptionist smiled at him.
sentences.text_native: La réceptionniste lui a souri.

sentences.text_target: Tom said hello and sat on a chair.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm sed həˈləʊ ænd sæt ɒn ə tʃeə/
sentences.text_native: Tom a dit bonjour et s'est assis sur une chaise.

sentences.text_target: He waited for ten minutes.
sentences.text_native: Il a attendu pendant dix minutes.

sentences.text_target: A friendly nurse called his name.
sentences.text_native: Une infirmière sympathique a appelé son nom.

sentences.text_target: Tom stood up and followed her.
sentences.text_native: Tom s'est levé et l'a suivie.

sentences.text_target: They entered a small medical room.
sentences.text_native: Ils sont entrés dans un petit cabinet médical.

sentences.text_target: The nurse measured his weight and height.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə nɜːs ˈmeʒəd hɪz weɪt ænd haɪt/
sentences.text_native: L'infirmière a mesuré son poids et sa taille.

sentences.text_target: She also checked his temperature.
sentences.text_native: Elle a également pris sa température.

sentences.text_target: He had a bad fever.
sentences.text_native: Il avait une forte fièvre.

sentences.text_target: Then the doctor opened the door.
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, le médecin a ouvert la porte.

sentences.text_target: The doctor asked about his problem.
sentences.text_native: Le médecin l'a interrogé sur son problème.

sentences.text_target: Tom explained that he felt very tired.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm ɪkˈspleɪnd ðæt hiː felt ˈveri ˈtaɪəd/
sentences.text_native: Tom a expliqué qu'il se sentait très fatigué.

sentences.text_target: He also had a headache and a stomach ache.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈɔːlsəʊ hæd ə ˈhedeɪk ænd ə ˈstʌmək eɪk/
sentences.text_native: Il avait aussi mal à la tête et au ventre.

sentences.text_target: The doctor looked at his throat.
sentences.text_native: Le médecin a examiné sa gorge.

sentences.text_target: Tom opened his mouth and said ah.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm ˈəʊpənd hɪz maʊθ ænd sed ɑː/
sentences.text_native: Tom a ouvert la bouche et a dit « aah ».

sentences.text_target: The doctor listened to his chest.
sentences.text_native: Le médecin a ausculté sa poitrine.

sentences.text_target: He asked Tom to take a deep breath.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ɑːskt tɒm tuː teɪk ə diːp breθ/
sentences.text_native: Il a demandé à Tom de prendre une grande inspiration.

sentences.text_target: The doctor smiled and made a diagnosis.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɒktə smaɪld ænd meɪd ə ˈdaɪəɡnəʊsɪs/
sentences.text_native: Le médecin a souri et a posé un diagnostic.

sentences.text_target: He said it was a simple throat infection.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː sed ɪt wɒz ə ˈsɪmpəl θrəʊt ɪnˈfekʃən/
sentences.text_native: Il a dit que c'était une simple infection de la gorge.

sentences.text_target: The doctor wrote a prescription.
sentences.text_native: Le médecin a rédigé une ordonnance.

sentences.text_target: Tom needed to take special medicine.
sentences.text_native: Tom avait besoin de prendre un médicament spécifique.

sentences.text_target: He had to take medicine three times a day.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː hæd tuː teɪk ˈmedsɪn θriː taɪmz ə deɪ/
sentences.text_native: Il devait prendre son médicament trois fois par jour.

sentences.text_target: The doctor told him to take a rest.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɒktə təʊld hɪm tuː teɪk ə rest/
sentences.text_native: Le médecin lui a conseillé de se reposer.

sentences.text_target: Tom thanked the doctor for his help.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm θæŋkt ðə ˈdɒktə fɔː hɪz help/
sentences.text_native: Tom a remercié le médecin pour son aide.

sentences.text_target: He walked to the local pharmacy.
sentences.text_native: Il est allé à pied jusqu'à la pharmacie du coin.

sentences.text_target: He gave the paper to the pharmacist.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ɡeɪv ðə ˈpeɪpə tuː ðə ˈfɑːməsɪst/
sentences.text_native: Il a remis l'ordonnance au pharmacien.

sentences.text_target: Tom paid with his card.
sentences.text_native: Tom a payé avec sa carte bancaire.

sentences.text_target: Then he left and went back home to recover.
sentences.phonetic: /ðen hiː left ænd went bæk həʊm tuː rɪˈkʌvə/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, il est parti et est rentré chez lui pour se reposer.
